name: artcraft
description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
one_liner: A design tool that lets you stage a 3D scene, pose it, light it, and render a finished image or shot, instead of just typing a prompt and hoping for the best.
buyer: A small e-commerce brand or boutique creative agency that currently pays for product photoshoots or stock footage for marketing visuals.
business_use_cases: An e-commerce seller stages and renders their own product shots (a candle on a counter, a jacket on a model) instead of booking a studio photographer.
An indie game or animation studio uses it to block out and render scene concepts quickly, cutting pre-production time and cost.
A marketing agency offers 'AI-staged product visuals' as a faster, cheaper service tier for small clients who can't afford traditional photography.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'product photo as a service' subscription where sellers upload a product and get staged renders back on a schedule.
Sell premium scene/lighting template packs built for specific industries (jewelry, food, apparel).

steal_this: Launch a weekend side-business offering e-commerce sellers 5 staged product renders for a flat fee, using this tool to replace a traditional photoshoot.
